name: Against the Hatecrest
summary: In Feathermoon Stronghold, Shandris sends you to Latronicus as she weighs the naga threat.

sections.title: Shandris Weighs the Risk
sections.body:
General Shandris Feathermoon sends you to Latronicus Moonspear, her second. He has watched the naga forces closely, and Shandris must judge the wider danger they pose.

She would like to commit a full force against them. But then Feathermoon Stronghold would be open to a direct attack from the Horde, or something worse. Latronicus awaits you in the stronghold.

sections.title: What Latronicus Intends
sections.body:
Latronicus Moonspear says General Shandris charged him with confronting the naga directly. His plan has two parts: weaken their numbers and their command, then learn what they are doing in the ruins.

With your help, the naga can be countered while Feathermoon Stronghold stays secure.

faq.q: Why does Shandris Feathermoon send you to Latronicus?
faq.answer: Shandris will not commit a full force against the naga if it leaves Feathermoon Stronghold open to the Horde, or something worse. She sends you to Latronicus, her second, who has been watching the naga.
Latronicus Moonspear is in Feathermoon Stronghold, where Shandris sends you to report to him.
You return to Feathermoon Stronghold, and Shandris sends you on to Latronicus.
